summary: Parse command-line arguments with Node util.parseArgs option schemas, strictness, positionals, defaults, negatives, and optional token output.

requirements.config: statically known shape or represented by NodeUtilParseArgsConfig
requirements.argv_source: explicit args or NodeProcess-compatible process.argv slice

semantics.return: object with values and positionals; tokens when requested
semantics.strict: unknown options/type mismatches throw in strict mode
semantics.options: boolean/string options, short aliases, multiple/default values, allowNegative, allowPositionals and tokens supported per Node version
semantics.values_prototype: the returned values object has a null prototype in Node, avoiding inherited option names

caveats: System.CommandLine and ad-hoc parsers have different tokenization/error/default semantics.

tests.name: edge values object has null prototype
